## Reading guide

* **ranking inverted**: the detector systematically scores bona fide recordings of the target corpus as more spoof-like than its spoofs — the signature of corpus-specific cues whose direction flips across corpora (see the dataset shortcut audit, Sec. III-C of the paper).
* **ranking transfers, threshold does not**: scores still separate the classes (high AUC) but the validation threshold no longer sits between them — a calibration shift.
